summary: Verdict: pass. No Blocker or Major finding in the production delta d74cf4c..c8c5e9e. The rank keys at 9 decimals, the raw values in real-work.json with one rounding in preview.sh, the alias rule, Object.hasOwn on byEffort, the audit_name strip, and the CSS change are correct. guide.ts reads only first_round.value, tasks, allowed, and model, and it rounds the rate once. No other reader of real-work.json exists. An independent oracle from the spec text over the real files gives 0 differences on the new preview. real-work 13, guide 17, preview-gate 99, and adversarial-p4 18 pass, each with exit 0.
evidence: HEAD check: git rev-parse HEAD returned c8c5e9ecca070beeb54fec27f79542d24ccecfc1. The production delta d74cf4c..c8c5e9e is cea0a90 only: real-work.ts, preview.sh, and pages/real-work.html. d20d611 and c8c5e9e change only adversarial-p4.test.ts, and 559dda9 changes only plan.md. git status --short shows only the six untracked paths that existed at the start.

Rank keys (FR-3): real-work.ts rankKey rounds the rate and the rework to 9 decimals in compareRows only. The order of a pick and of the table both come from compareRows, so a float-noise tie now falls to the next rule (lower rework, then fewer escapes, then more runs, then model key).

Numbers (D16): real-work.json now holds the raw weighted mean_rework, cleanup_share, tokens_per_accepted, findings_per_run, and unknown_share. preview.sh rounds each value one time (one_decimal, pct, tokens_text, two_decimals, footer .1f), and none of these formatters changed in the delta. guide.ts:356-371 reads first_round.value and tasks and rounds the rate one time with Math.round, so the overview evidence and the pick are unchanged. grep finds no other reader of real-work.json in harness (outside the tests), docs, or pages. The real preview text holds no number with 4 or more decimals. model-guide.json rows equal the rows of the d74cf4c-era preview (/tmp/ra2-pv-real).
Alias rule (ADV-6): aaIndex fills the direct keys in a first pass and the aliases in a second pass, so a direct key wins over an alias in any file order.
byEffort (ADV-7): netScoreOf reads byEffort[variant] only when Object.hasOwn is true, else the primary row, as spec D16 AA net score says.
audit_name (ADV-5): preview.sh:367 removes [1m] and the #variant suffix before the model-names.json lookup, which is the page B model key rule of D16 and D17.

CSS (ADV-1, ADV-2): the header text may wrap, the model cells get min-width 10em, and table_wrap now writes one scroll hint after each scroll box, the More columns tables too. Observation, below Major: the hint shows at each width, also for a table that fits, although the table_wrap docstring says that such a hint stays hidden. Spec D16 Width requires a visible hint for a wide table and does not forbid it for a fitting table.

Oracle: a Python script written from spec D16 Data source and FR-3 (not from the TypeScript) read ra-outcomes, aa-reliability, allowed-routes, and model-names of 2026-11-17. It compared the new preview /tmp/ra4-pv-real: the producer order and cells (Tasks, First-round accept %, Rework, Cleanup %, Tokens) of 4 ranked rows, the checker order and cells (Runs, Pass %, Findings per run, Escapes, Net score) of 20 ranked rows, both marks on each ranked row, the presence of 12 and 17 too-few rows, the ten top lines (model key, rate, count), and the footer (rows 217, routes 53, unknown 6, share 2.8 %). TOTAL DIFFS 0.

Tests at HEAD, one file at a time with --configLoader native --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot: real-work 13 passed (13); guide 17 passed (17); preview-gate 99 passed (99); adversarial-p4 18 passed (18). Each exit code is 0.
